FAQ

Common Questions

Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?

Walk-ins are welcome for hair and express services, but evenings and Saturdays book up fast. We recommend messaging us on WhatsApp to lock in your time. Running late or need to reschedule? Let us know 3 hours ahead — no charge, no fuss.

It's my first visit — will I be pressured to buy a package?

Never. We charge by the service, exactly as listed. After your appointment your specialist may suggest what would help your skin or hair — whether you book it is entirely up to you. It's the rule our regulars mention most in reviews.

How long does an appointment take?

Most facials run 60–75 minutes, the hot stone massage is 90 minutes, and a cut with blowout is about an hour. Add 10 minutes for your consultation and a coffee or tea — we never rush you out the door.

Where do I park, and how's transit?

There's metered street parking on Bank Street and the side streets, plus two public parking garages within a three-minute walk. We're also a short walk from Parliament Station on the O-Train, and several OC Transpo routes stop right on Bank.

What payment methods do you accept?

Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Interac, Apple Pay and cash are all welcome. Gift cards are available in the studio and by WhatsApp — a favorite for birthdays and Mother's Day.
